title: An .npmrc with an auth token is served
summary: The npm config is downloadable and carries an auth token for a package registry.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and "html" not in header("content-type") and body_contains("_authToken") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Remove the file from the web root and rotate the token.
